raw_segments.text: Receiving the brimming pewter and turning to the harpooniers, he ordered them to produce
Then ranging them before him near the capstan, with their harpoons in their hands, while
his three mates stood at his side with their lances, and the rest of the ship's company
formed a circle round the group.
He stood for an instant searchingly eyeing every man of his crew.
But those wild eyes met his, as the bloodshot eyes of the prairie wolves meet the eye of
their leader, ere he rushes on at their head in the trail of the bison, but alas, only
to fall into the hidden snare of the Indian.
